18335402089335cd6a5d.en: Direct speech shows the exact words someone says, inside speech marks.
18335402089335cd6a5d.id: Kalimat langsung (direct speech) menunjukkan kata-kata yang persis diucapkan seseorang, di dalam tanda petik (speech marks).

3500a3aadfb99f6d6397.en: Punctuation that ends the spoken words goes inside the speech marks.
3500a3aadfb99f6d6397.id: Tanda baca yang mengakhiri ucapan ditaruh di dalam tanda petik.

e147875d3e33b38db189.en: Start a new line each time a different person speaks.
e147875d3e33b38db189.id: Mulai baris baru setiap kali ada orang lain yang berbicara.

c979bad564e07eece39f.en: Reported speech tells what someone said without speech marks. The verb usually moves into the past.
c979bad564e07eece39f.id: Kalimat tidak langsung (reported speech) menyampaikan ucapan seseorang tanpa tanda petik. Kata kerjanya biasanya berubah ke bentuk lampau (past).

362a1bc2405c80d67e5b.en: Pronouns and time words change too.
362a1bc2405c80d67e5b.id: Kata ganti (pronoun) dan kata waktu juga berubah.

088f67e16595d1dd24c6.en: The exclamation mark goes inside the speech marks, and shouted continues the sentence with a small s.
088f67e16595d1dd24c6.id: Tanda seru (exclamation mark) diletakkan di dalam tanda petik (speech marks), dan shouted melanjutkan kalimat dengan huruf kecil s.

30036917b382fb9f4384.en: The exclamation mark belongs inside the speech marks.
30036917b382fb9f4384.id: Tanda seru (exclamation mark) seharusnya ada di dalam tanda petik.

1f15ed00f15c0b6647af.en: No comma is needed after the exclamation mark.
1f15ed00f15c0b6647af.id: Koma tidak diperlukan setelah tanda seru.

095f9354b044f34c9a65.en: Like becomes liked in reported speech: Arif said that he liked football.
095f9354b044f34c9a65.id: Like menjadi liked dalam kalimat tidak langsung (reported speech): Arif said that he liked football.

891bc1fb26a0b8f2d6d9.en: Where is my bag is a question, so it ends with a question mark inside the speech marks.
891bc1fb26a0b8f2d6d9.id: Where is my bag adalah pertanyaan, jadi diakhiri tanda tanya (question mark) di dalam tanda petik (speech marks).

08432cd6e643c52be1c9.en: Rudi is asking a question, so a full stop is not right.
08432cd6e643c52be1c9.id: Rudi sedang bertanya, jadi titik (full stop) tidak tepat.

40d3bad48477656abc4b.en: A comma is used when spoken words are a statement, not a question.
40d3bad48477656abc4b.id: Koma dipakai bila kata-kata yang diucapkan berupa pernyataan, bukan pertanyaan.

245bb8178d955c144b49.en: An exclamation mark shows strong feeling, but Rudi is asking something.
245bb8178d955c144b49.id: Tanda seru (exclamation mark) menunjukkan perasaan yang kuat, tetapi Rudi sedang menanyakan sesuatu.

fb68491823acb64ccebf.en: The words inside the speech marks are what Lia said. Lia shouted is the reporting clause.
fb68491823acb64ccebf.id: Kata-kata di dalam tanda petik (speech marks) adalah yang diucapkan Lia. Lia shouted adalah bagian pengantar (reporting clause).

b2f8dfaf31dc40865fc3.en: The question is inside the speech marks with its question mark, and asked Tono continues the sentence with a small a.
b2f8dfaf31dc40865fc3.id: Pertanyaannya berada di dalam tanda petik (speech marks) bersama tanda tanyanya, dan asked Tono melanjutkan kalimat dengan huruf kecil a.

2e3989e6fec062a2a891.en: The question mark belongs inside the speech marks, straight after ruler.
2e3989e6fec062a2a891.id: Tanda tanya seharusnya ada di dalam tanda petik, tepat setelah ruler.

25203ac62b1380f4ed87.en: Speech marks are missing around the spoken words.
25203ac62b1380f4ed87.id: Tanda petik di sekitar kata-kata yang diucapkan tidak ada.

fa3fdcb2e28a70ad458a.en: The question mark should come before the closing speech mark, not after it.
fa3fdcb2e28a70ad458a.id: Tanda tanya seharusnya ditulis sebelum tanda petik penutup, bukan sesudahnya.

89bb0db1b7cf7deb90e0.en: When the spoken words come first and the sentence continues, a comma goes inside the closing speech marks: “We are going to the zoo,” said Dad.
89bb0db1b7cf7deb90e0.id: Saat kata-kata yang diucapkan berada di depan dan kalimatnya berlanjut, koma diletakkan di dalam tanda petik penutup: “We are going to the zoo,” said Dad.

2e7763625595ab404698.en: A comma after said would split the words that tell us who is speaking.
2e7763625595ab404698.id: Koma setelah said akan memisahkan kata-kata yang memberi tahu siapa yang berbicara.

86291a1b7c9a41368d89.en: The sentence ends after Dad, so it needs a full stop there.
86291a1b7c9a41368d89.id: Kalimatnya berakhir setelah Dad, jadi perlu titik di situ.

647049b87b82a4a6f3ed.en: Nothing comes before the speech, so no comma is needed there.
647049b87b82a4a6f3ed.id: Tidak ada kata sebelum ucapan itu, jadi koma tidak diperlukan di situ.

d3f25cfdb026515e7c19.en: Spoken words go inside speech marks, and each new speaker starts on a new line. This helps the reader follow who is talking.
d3f25cfdb026515e7c19.id: Kata-kata yang diucapkan ditulis di dalam tanda petik (speech marks), dan setiap pembicara baru mulai di baris baru. Ini membantu pembaca mengikuti siapa yang sedang berbicara.

d136d74cf4ef21462a83.en: Capital letters go on the first spoken word and on names, not on every word.
d136d74cf4ef21462a83.id: Huruf kapital dipakai pada kata pertama yang diucapkan dan pada nama, bukan pada setiap kata.

1a91d693b867f462e5f9.en: Questions in speech need question marks inside the speech marks.
1a91d693b867f462e5f9.id: Pertanyaan dalam ucapan perlu tanda tanya di dalam tanda petik.

5d91c04af47f1e789750.en: In reported speech, am changes to was because Maya said it in the past: Maya said that she was tired.
5d91c04af47f1e789750.id: Dalam kalimat tidak langsung (reported speech), am berubah menjadi was karena Maya mengatakannya pada waktu yang lalu: Maya said that she was tired.

08580878e86e4af55f07.en: Direct speech uses speech marks around the exact words. Reported speech retells the words without speech marks, often with that or if.
08580878e86e4af55f07.id: Kalimat langsung (direct speech) memakai tanda petik (speech marks) untuk mengapit kata-kata yang persis diucapkan. Kalimat tidak langsung (reported speech) menceritakan kembali kata-kata itu tanpa tanda petik, sering dengan that atau if.

9a8fd762615cbbe00dee.en: Ben’s I becomes he, you becomes me, will becomes would and tomorrow becomes the next day.
9a8fd762615cbbe00dee.id: I yang diucapkan Ben menjadi he, you menjadi me, will menjadi would, dan tomorrow menjadi the next day.

d47a34ad27d7b19522bd.en: The pronouns are swapped. Ben is the one who will help.
d47a34ad27d7b19522bd.id: Kata gantinya (pronoun) tertukar. Ben yang akan membantu.

425da07eafeb08df8013.en: You should change to me, because Ben was speaking to me.
425da07eafeb08df8013.id: You harus berubah menjadi me, karena Ben berbicara kepadaku.

fd62f9ba1da820f71bcf.en: Reported speech does not use speech marks.
fd62f9ba1da820f71bcf.id: Reported speech tidak memakai tanda petik.

e9f03231e4e5494eeb29.en: A yes or no question is reported with if. You becomes I, did you finish becomes had finished, and the sentence ends with a full stop.
e9f03231e4e5494eeb29.id: Pertanyaan yang dijawab yes atau no dilaporkan dengan if. You menjadi I, did you finish menjadi had finished, dan kalimatnya diakhiri titik (full stop).

92e724f250208f58999c.en: Reported questions are written as statements, without a question mark.
92e724f250208f58999c.id: Pertanyaan dalam reported speech ditulis seperti pernyataan, tanpa tanda tanya.

d69696a36eeef6a041e8.en: You should change to I, because Mum was asking me.
d69696a36eeef6a041e8.id: You harus berubah menjadi I, karena Mum bertanya kepadaku.

4ca9cfb52a869773cc48.en: There should be no comma before if, and no question mark.
4ca9cfb52a869773cc48.id: Seharusnya tidak ada koma sebelum if, dan tidak ada tanda tanya.

6ff4ef06e30b8af4c555.en: We becomes they, visited becomes had visited, this becomes that and yesterday becomes the day before.
6ff4ef06e30b8af4c555.id: We menjadi they, visited menjadi had visited, this menjadi that, dan yesterday menjadi the day before.

ba9e27ea02f18b5449ea.en: We should change to they, and the time and place words should change too.
ba9e27ea02f18b5449ea.id: We harus berubah menjadi they, dan kata untuk waktu dan tempat juga harus berubah.

cb8406adbeee8ec2eea0.en: In reported speech, this usually becomes that and yesterday becomes the day before.
cb8406adbeee8ec2eea0.id: Dalam reported speech, this biasanya menjadi that dan yesterday menjadi the day before.

e1d392f9b6424dfd9035.en: Yesterday means the day before, not the day after.
e1d392f9b6424dfd9035.id: Yesterday berarti the day before, bukan the day after.

d26c72f253884af823e7.en: The spoken words go inside speech marks, with a comma before the closing marks.
d26c72f253884af823e7.id: Kata-kata yang diucapkan ditulis di dalam tanda petik (speech marks), dengan koma sebelum tanda petik penutup.

06a033baba2878017376.en: Direct speech has speech marks around the exact words.
06a033baba2878017376.id: Kalimat langsung (direct speech) punya tanda petik (speech marks) yang mengapit kata-kata yang persis diucapkan.

3b0012287c1d4004e067.en: This reports what Tom said without his exact words.
3b0012287c1d4004e067.id: Ini melaporkan ucapan Tom tanpa memakai kata-katanya yang persis.

57c16230ac8ce5da10bf.en: Are moves back to were in reported speech.
57c16230ac8ce5da10bf.id: Are berubah ke bentuk lampau were dalam kalimat tidak langsung (reported speech).

9591f98e535c0e42842c.en: Like changes to liked in reported speech.
9591f98e535c0e42842c.id: Like berubah menjadi liked dalam kalimat tidak langsung (reported speech).

1e12f9db5c18fb51d49f.en: Will changes to would in reported speech.
1e12f9db5c18fb51d49f.id: Will berubah menjadi would dalam kalimat tidak langsung (reported speech).

cadc94c4a0e95d737e4f.en: Today, tomorrow, yesterday and now depend on when the words were spoken. Always, never and often do not.
cadc94c4a0e95d737e4f.id: Today, tomorrow, yesterday, dan now bergantung pada kapan kata-kata itu diucapkan. Always, never, dan often tidak.

36608e0c7ad8f2dabcf0.en: Can changes to could, will to would, am to was and have to had.
36608e0c7ad8f2dabcf0.id: Can berubah menjadi could, will menjadi would, am menjadi was, dan have menjadi had.

aa8cd3b2f177b71ec99e.en: I becomes he and am making becomes was making.
aa8cd3b2f177b71ec99e.id: I menjadi he dan am making menjadi was making.

1d8d55db1d45b96e49b7.en: The tense should move back to was.
1d8d55db1d45b96e49b7.id: Bentuk waktunya (tense) harus mundur menjadi was.

c3fcebc104c17a63ca2a.en: The pronoun should change to he.
c3fcebc104c17a63ca2a.id: Kata ganti (pronoun) harus berubah menjadi he.

7896ddcc31cc8e1f8ee0.en: Making and made have different meanings.
7896ddcc31cc8e1f8ee0.id: Making dan made punya arti yang berbeda.

6b8f55257ed6b9f0d3cb.en: In reported questions the verb follows the subject and moves back.
6b8f55257ed6b9f0d3cb.id: Dalam pertanyaan tidak langsung (reported question), kata kerja (verb) berada setelah subjek (subject) dan berubah ke bentuk lampau.

58642b3d6a94797436b2.en: Reported questions do not use question word order.
58642b3d6a94797436b2.id: Pertanyaan dalam reported speech tidak memakai susunan kata pertanyaan.

dbebf29e63684042636c.en: A reported question ends with a full stop.
dbebf29e63684042636c.id: Pertanyaan dalam reported speech diakhiri dengan titik (full stop).

50198091e461472e1b3d.en: Do not add that before a question word.
50198091e461472e1b3d.id: Jangan menambahkan that sebelum kata tanya.

50a8da591fc940b74bb9.en: Reported speech often changes the tense and the pronouns.
50a8da591fc940b74bb9.id: Kalimat tidak langsung (reported speech) sering mengubah bentuk waktu (tense) dan kata ganti (pronoun).

93b81d0ad3548ddf08bf.en: Will should become would and you should become him.
93b81d0ad3548ddf08bf.id: Will harus menjadi would dan you harus menjadi him.

3b36d1d221caf29beda8.en: You should become Bayu or him, and tonight becomes that night.
3b36d1d221caf29beda8.id: You harus menjadi Bayu atau him, dan tonight menjadi that night.

5311d7e0b77bb9dc5327.id: Told harus diikuti orang yang diberi tahu.

2801a13a5be6a0737b57.en: Am saving becomes was saving, will becomes would and next month becomes the following month.
2801a13a5be6a0737b57.id: Am saving menjadi was saving, will menjadi would, dan next month menjadi the following month.

99aadd59dddc3990ab6d.en: When the sentence continues, use commas and a lower case letter.
99aadd59dddc3990ab6d.id: Saat kalimatnya berlanjut, pakai koma dan huruf kecil.

faae56e1c08ee579562b.en: If a full stop is used, the next speech needs a capital letter.
faae56e1c08ee579562b.id: Kalau memakai titik, ucapan berikutnya perlu huruf kapital.

e9d2c9a06724761571d0.en: Reported speech often changes tense, place and time words.
e9d2c9a06724761571d0.id: Kalimat tidak langsung (reported speech) sering mengubah bentuk waktu (tense), kata tempat, dan kata waktu.

fe7b8cfb80d1f470ec1a.en: Here and yesterday were not changed.

41d6ff4e760299a2880a.en: Would see changes the meaning to the future.
41d6ff4e760299a2880a.id: Would see mengubah maknanya menjadi waktu yang akan datang.

b1388bed9126fd9adfdc.en: Direct speech uses the exact words, so speech marks show the words said.
b1388bed9126fd9adfdc.id: Kalimat langsung (direct speech) memakai kata-kata yang persis diucapkan, jadi tanda petik (speech marks) menunjukkan kata-kata itu.

e4239e72bfb4e7caaa8b.en: Speech marks are needed around I am hungry because Tom said those words.
e4239e72bfb4e7caaa8b.id: Tanda petik (speech marks) diperlukan untuk mengapit I am hungry karena Tom mengucapkan kata-kata itu.

27a5290f87ef3f5e21d6.en: Reported speech tells what was said without the exact words or speech marks.
27a5290f87ef3f5e21d6.id: Kalimat tidak langsung (reported speech) menceritakan apa yang dikatakan tanpa kata-kata yang persis dan tanpa tanda petik (speech marks).

8a517bae8c2588c5dd22.en: Reported speech does not use speech marks because the exact words are not used.
8a517bae8c2588c5dd22.id: Kalimat tidak langsung (reported speech) tidak memakai tanda petik (speech marks) karena kata-kata yang persis tidak dipakai.

4018f2d3eb9deaa0559a.en: If Ali says "I am happy", the report is Ali said that he was happy.
4018f2d3eb9deaa0559a.id: Kalau Ali berkata "I am happy", laporannya adalah Ali said that he was happy.

0f176e719a31cd9db8c6.en: For example, "Where are you going?" asked Ella. The question mark stays inside the speech marks.
0f176e719a31cd9db8c6.id: Misalnya, "Where are you going?" asked Ella. Tanda tanya (question mark) tetap di dalam tanda petik (speech marks).

7a6c2e9d0088efbcfdc1.en: Start a new line each time a different person speaks. It helps the reader see who is talking.
7a6c2e9d0088efbcfdc1.id: Mulai baris baru setiap kali orang yang berbeda berbicara. Ini membantu pembaca melihat siapa yang sedang berbicara.

734e8e4c5e1c65ad1cfb.en: In reported speech, am changes to was.
734e8e4c5e1c65ad1cfb.id: Dalam kalimat tidak langsung (reported speech), am berubah menjadi was.
